name: Research & Evidence
tagline: A precise evidence desk where the research leads
idea: A well-kept research desk where publications, data and methods lead: a searchable report library with filters, a labelled data chart, key findings set as figures and footnoted articles. Quiet teal and amber marks guide the eye.
fit: Journalists, researchers and policymakers can find, cite and download evidence quickly, while supporters see exactly how their gifts turn into documented results. It builds trust by showing methods, sources and corrections openly.
informedBy: Report covers that set publications apart, with a filterable research archive
Visible methodology, finances and corrections as everyday trust signals
Long reads with contents, footnotes and downloads
distinct: Built around finding and checking evidence: search leads the header, and a report table and a labelled data chart take centre stage.
buttons: Square teal buttons with arrows, outlined graphite for downloads, underlined links and monospaced filter chips.
imageDirection: Few, small images in a teal duotone, always captioned. Report covers, charts and key figures carry the visual weight.
navigation: Wordmark, prominent search bar and outlined Donate, with sections below. Mobile: menu button, search first.
visualCharacter: Precise, structured and calm, with hairline rules and data
contentEmphasis: Reports, data, methods and citations; stories support them
bestFor: Organisations whose credibility rests on research, serving journalists, policymakers and evidence-minded donors
tradeoffs: Can feel cool and text-heavy to first-time supporters; needs disciplined data publishing and regular new charts to stay alive.
